usageNotes: Use this to clear a TFA lockout for a user who has been locked out after too many failed two-factor authentication attempts. The caller must hold the `User.Modify` privilege on the user's realm or group. Returns `true` on success; the user can then attempt TFA login again immediately.

examples.summary: Unlock TFA for a local Proxmox user who is locked out

tips: The userid must use the full `name@realm` format (e.g., `admin@pam`, `jsmith@pve`).
This only clears the TFA lockout state — it does not remove or modify the user's configured TFA methods.
If the user is completely locked out of TFA (lost device/keys), remove or reset their TFA via the TFA endpoints after unlocking.
API tokens are permitted (`allowtoken: true`), so this can be scripted in automated helpdesk workflows.
